# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read `AGENTS.md`, `AI_AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `VISION.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, active ADRs, and relevant product specifications before suggesting changes.

Inspect existing implementation first. Preserve domain boundaries, strict TypeScript, privacy, explainable AI, accessibility, and the approved Sartoria brand direction. Do not invent product rules, credentials, integrations, or dependencies. Prefer complete, tested vertical slices over isolated snippets.
